content.title: Apollo Said to Invest in Brad Jacobs’ Distribution Firm QXO
content.summary: The investment into Greenwich, Connecticut-based QXO is also backed by other firms including Franklin Templeton, the people said, asking not to be identified because the matter is private.  The financing for the company, which is led by billionaire and serial dealmaker Brad Jacobs, will be in convertible preferred stock, they added.  The investors’ initial conversion price into common stock will be $23.25 per share, roughly 18% above QXO’s Friday closing price of $19.72, the people said.
